prompt_fragment: This asset is a card face. Compose for a vertical 3:4 frame with a strong focal subject and room for card framing or overlay treatment.
raw_description:
A single centered compass rose in dark ink on a warm-cream parchment
field, faint concentric circle patterns radiating outward, aged paper
texture with subtle foxing at the corners. Slate-blue accent on the
compass needle. Museum collection cataloging feel.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor archival plate on aged vellum parchment, a single compass rose centered on warm cream field with faint concentric radiating rings, slate-blue needle axis punctuating the composition.

subjects.description: Eight-pointed ink compass rose, fine nib linework, ornate directional flourishes, concentric faint rings radiating outward, worn hatching in the cardinal quadrants
Aged vellum surface, subtle foxing clusters at all four corners, faint fiber grain beneath, soft tonal variation across the field
Slim elongated needle bisecting the rose, crisp ink edge, single bold directional accent distinguishing north point
